name: @kitn.ai/ui-app-ops-console
description: Rung 5 of the iteration ladder: an internal ops console. An assistant proposes consequential actions as interactive cards the operator answers in the conversation, and a live run board is framed beside the thread from a SECOND origin through <kai-remote>. React + Vite, two dev servers. Scripted mock by default, OpenRouter when a key is present.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.board.config.ts
